positions.as_written: Place the leg in the figure of four position.
Follow it with a finger from the lateral femoral epicondyle down to the fibular head, noting tenderness and whether the cord is palpable along its length.
Compare with the other knee in the same position, because the prominence of the cord varies between people.
A disrupted ligament should prompt examination of the common peroneal nerve, which lies just behind the fibular neck.
